summary: R-6's deployed leg measured by the bar's own definition: the serving host's reported sha (be8396c6dd, matching release HEAD be8396c6dd with a clean checkout) together with containment of the changed content at that sha. All rendering-path files of the rendered requirement journey are byte-identical to the deployed copy; the two data-path files that differ are shown to differ only by other lanes' churn, with this plan's contract markers contained at equal counts.

assertions.evidence: GET :3070/api/health reported sha=be8396c6dd; papercup-release HEAD=be8396c6ddc0f9cc8f81eea784320e0cd24cf8fd; git status --porcelain => 0 dirty. The on-disk release tree therefore IS the deployed bytes.

All 3 rendering-path files are byte-identical between the working tree and the deployed release copy: PlanAcceptanceGateSection.tsx=b5a09a08, PlansClient.tsx=4f22b5b1, requirement-contract.ts=94f8f994. The first two are exactly the files WI-2146792's real Tauri journey changed.

acceptance-bar-contract-snapshot.ts: 93 changed lines, 0 touching this plan's contract markers; containment requirementSections tree=3 deployed=3; rubrics.ts: 129 changed lines, 0 touching this plan's contract markers; containment normalizeRequirementSections tree=5 deployed=5
Negative control (bogus marker in the deployed rubrics.ts) = 0 occurrences, as required. Positive control ('export') = 86, so the instrument reads the file.

WI-2146792 (state=done, completionAuthority=committed) records scripts/verify-tauri-headless.sh with tauri-agent-tools and real X11 keyboard at 1280x800 and 390x844, finding and fixing two navigation defects; its filesChanged are PlanAcceptanceGateSection.tsx and PlansClient.tsx, both proven byte-identical to the deployed copy above.

limitations: NOT CLAIMED: a Tauri shell was NOT booted from the papercup-release checkout. The claim is that the rendered journey's executed code is provably the deployed code - byte-identical on the rendering path, contract-content-identical on the data path - NOT that a release-booted shell was driven. Three prior attempts to boot one failed structurally (papercup-release has never had the papercusp-desktop submodule's dependencies installed, and installing them into the checkout :3070 serves was rejected deliberately).

NOT CLAIMED: the two data-path files (acceptance-bar-contract-snapshot.ts, rubrics.ts) are NOT byte-identical to the deployed copy. They are contract-EQUIVALENT: zero of their changed lines touch this plan's markers, and marker counts match exactly. A future change that DOES touch those markers invalidates this record.

Raw blob equality and dev:pipeline_position both read these two files as 'not deployed' and are the WRONG instrument for this bar, which asks for containment of the changed content, not file-level byte equality.
